meta.description: It's the first day of camp in this outrageous prequel to the hilarious 2001 cult classic movie. And at Camp Firewood, anything can happen.

videos.overview: It's the first morning at Camp Firewood, and the horny counselors are already making their moves, while something sinister is going on in the woods.

videos.title: Lunch
